conviction_note: Near-zero call. Any reader of the last 短信 can see the H1 plan miss (Q1 OP 4,356 against an H1 plan of 11,900, so Q2 would need about 25% above IDOM's best quarter ever), and the stock is already -16% since Q1 at roughly 8x plan EPS. The release turns on whether the full-year 24,000 OP guide (IFIS consensus 23,380) is held or cut. Two peer reads point to a strong Q2 against a weak base, and the margin long (信用倍率 5.27) keeps some sellers in place for a cut. Findings sum to +0.10 and the scaled number to -0.12; both are small because the evidence offsets, not because the move will be small. This name's print reactions are large (estimated history median 8.6%, last four 2-7%).
bar: Company H1 (Mar-Aug 2026) OP plan 11,900m yen, unchanged since 2026-04-13 and restated in the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260710591245.pdf). My estimate of H1 OP is about 10,300m (Q1 4,356 plus Q2 about 5,900-6,000, a record quarter on a weak Q2 FY26 base of 4,593), which is -13% against the plan. The full-year bar the stock trades on is the IFIS consensus of OP 23,380 / ordinary 21,800 against the company's 24,000 / 22,400 (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7599, read 2026-10-14). There is no sourced H1 consensus, so the quarter-level bar is the company plan only.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register, as of 2026-09-29: 0.68% of shares held by one seller, down from 0.72% (-0.04pt, mild covering) (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 5.27x (baseline; also 5.27 on kabutan 2026-10-14), so leveraged retail is crowded long. That is the one setup where a visible miss still has sellers. There is no option skew in Japan. Run-up is -5.27% over 20 days and -1.29% over 5 days. The stock has slid from 1,366 (2026-07-14) to 1,155 (2026-10-13) with no 適時開示 in between (https://kabutan.jp/stock/kabuka?code=7599). Tokai Tokyo cut to neutral, target 1850->1420, on 2026-07-28; Morgan Stanley MUFG kept overweight, target 2100->2000, on 2026-07-22.

findings.finding: Nextage (3186) reported its Jun-Aug 2026 quarter, the same three months as IDOM's Q2, on 2026-10-05: OP 7,536m, +27.6% YoY, units +17.7% YTD. IDOM's own Q2 FY26 base is depressed (OP 4,593, -18.5% YoY, after the auction-price misjudgment the company admitted on 2025-10-10), so an IDOM Q2 well up YoY and a record quarterly OP is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 printed OP +15% YoY and the stock fell -7.03% the next day (2026-07-15), because progress against the H1 plan was weak. Strong YoY quarters have been sold when the plan is the bar. Nextage itself fell -4.93% on this strong print (2026-10-06).
findings.why_not_priced: IDOM closed flat over the Nextage print week (1,155 on 10-05, 1,155 on 10-13) and stayed near its low. If the market read Nextage as a read-through, IDOM would have re-rated off 8x PER, and the IFIS consensus would not still sit unchanged at 21,800 ordinary as it has for 4 weeks. Partly priced, because peer prints are public, so sized small.
findings.independence: Same direction from a different source: イチネンHD (9619) raised H1 on 2026-10-13, citing used-car prices that stayed strong (中古車相場が引き続き好調) through Apr-Sep (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7599&b=n202610131034). USS raised its H1 guide on 2026-08-04 on a strong auction market (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260804/140120260804508133.pdf). Those two are filed as finding 6 on the price-environment line, not counted again here.

findings.finding: The H1 plan miss is arithmetic: Q1 OP 4,356 against H1 plan 11,900 means Q2 needs 7,544, about 25% above IDOM's best quarter ever (6,021, Sep-Nov 2025). The CFO called Q1 'やや出遅れた' against the H1 plan. Dividends follow a 30% payout (42.43 / 141.42 EPS), so the 21.06 interim forecast is likely trimmed with the miss, as IDOM revised its dividend forecast at the H1 print in 2023, 2024 and 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY26 H1: the miss was pre-released on 2025-10-10 (OP -28.6% against plan), and the stock rose +4.47% on the H1 print (estimated history, 2025-10-15). That is 悪材料出尽くし. Q1 FY27 weak progress: -7.03%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Anyone can compute the progress rate from the Q1 短信: kabutan printed 35.2% against a five-year average of 48.8%. The stock is -16% since 07-14 and trades at 8.1x the plan. What is left is the crowded margin long (5.27x), which can still sell a confirmed miss and a trimmed interim dividend in a yield-held, 優待-held register.
findings.independence: The CFO's own wording in the Q1 explanation text agrees (https://idom-inc.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/setsumei_text_20260714.pdf). Same company, different document.

findings.finding: IDOM revised its full-year forecast at or just before the H1 print in 5 of the last 6 years (FY2/21, 2/22, 2/23 at the H1 print; FY2/25 sales only, profit held; FY2/26 cut OP -9% on 2025-10-10). With H1 likely about 10-15% below plan, a full-year profit cut at this release is roughly a coin flip. A cut to the 21,000-22,000 area would land below the IFIS consensus of 23,380; holding 24,000 would be a relief.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2/25: at the 2024-10-15 H1 print, profit guide held and sales raised; the stock rose +15.99% (estimated history). FY2/26: the guide was cut -9% four days before the print, and the print day itself was +4.47%. Guide outcomes have moved this stock by high single to double digits.
findings.why_not_priced: IFIS consensus is only 2.6% below the company OP guide (23,380 against 24,000) and has not moved in 4 weeks, so the sell-side has not marked in a cut. The price may have: at 8.1x plan EPS and -16% since Q1, buy-side skepticism is deeper than the published consensus. That is why this is sized at the expected value of a coin flip with an asymmetric tilt toward the crowded long, not at the size of a cut.
findings.independence: The 2024-10-15 revision notice shows the other branch, profit held with H1 above plan (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20241015/140120241008595230.pdf). Revision count from the TDnet history list (https://webapi.yanoshin.jp/webapi/tdnet/list/7599.json). Consensus from https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7599.

findings.finding: Last year IDOM pre-released its H1 miss on 2025-10-10, four days early, when ordinary profit crossed the TSE -30% threshold (-31.6%). This year there is no 業績予想の修正 on TDnet by the morning of 2026-10-14. That weakly implies the H1 ordinary miss is under 30%, i.e. H1 ordinary of at least about 7,770 against the 11,100 plan, which caps the worst case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior case of a missing pre-release. In 2020-2022 IDOM published its H1 差異 notices on the results day itself, so the company does not always pre-release.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an inference from an absence, and few holders will have checked last year's threshold behaviour. Sized small because 2020-2022 show same-day 差異 filings, so the absence is weak evidence.
findings.independence: The kabutan IDOM news list shows no revision since 2026-07-14, only the 10-01 業種変更 notice (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7599). Same fact, different viewer.

findings.finding: USS Jul-Sep 2026 auction data: listings +14.7% YoY but contract rate 64.8% against 68.6% a year earlier. Apr-Jun was 65.1% against 62.9%. Supply rose faster than clearing in the quarter after IDOM's Q2. Last year the same kind of auction-price volatility caused IDOM's H1 miss and guide cut, so this is a mild risk to the H2 guide and wholesale GPU.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-10: the company blamed the auction-price swing for a -28.6% H1 OP miss and a -9% FY cut.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an industry proxy with macro-to-company transmission, and USS itself describes the market as strong. It matters only if IDOM's commentary on the H2 auction environment turns cautious. Sized small.
findings.independence: Cuts against finding 1, and イチネン reports strong prices through September. Proxy only.

findings.finding: イチネンHD (9619) raised its Apr-Sep ordinary profit +28.5% on 2026-10-13, citing used-car prices that stayed strong and lifted gains on off-lease car sales. A firm used-car price environment through IDOM's H1 supports wholesale GPU recovering from Q1's one-off disposal level (index 80) and helps inventory valuation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In FY2/25 a high auction market lifted the H1 sales guide (2024-10-15), and the stock rose +15.99% (estimated). In FY2/26 an auction swing hurt.
findings.why_not_priced: Published the evening before the print and not yet traded. It is a proxy from a different business (lease-end disposals), so it transmits weakly.
findings.independence: USS H1 guide raise on a strong market (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260804/140120260804508133.pdf), from a different company.

outside_window.finding: Mid-term plan OP target of 30,000 for FY2/28 is acknowledged as likely missed (FISCO, 2026-07-30). A new mid-term plan is pending and not dated inside this window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: plausible, about 50/50 that the FY OP 24,000 is cut (IFIS 23,380). No 修正 pre-filed. Returns: the interim dividend is payout-linked and likely trimmed from 21.06; no buyback expected; 優待 introduced in Jan 2026. New-year guide: not applicable (H1 print). baseline_tension: Mixed. The baseline's priced lean is slightly positive (+0.39: small short covering, run-up -5%) against a crowded margin long. My findings net to about zero: a visible H1 miss and guide-cut risk against a strong Q2 peer read-through and an easy comp. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY 24,000 with a record Q2 OP; I looked for it and it is plausible. A buyback is unlikely, and I checked the leverage and the filing history.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the H1-miss finding rests on a progress rate anyone can compute from the Q1 短信, so I moved it from -0.5 to -0.2 and p_up from 48 to 49. The guide-cut finding (-0.5) stays, because the release can ADD a forecast cut.
Rule 2: three negatives and three positives, so the sign is not tilted. I wrote the strongest positive (a held FY guide with a record Q2) into baseline_tension and confirmed I looked for it.
